The user wants a Traditional Chinese onboarding flow for a bookkeeping/budget app with three pages:

1. Page 1: Connect bank accounts to auto-import transactions
2. Page 2: Auto-categorize expenses
3. Page 3: Monthly budget reminders + CTA button

Fields:
- t1: max 16 characters
- b1: max 96 characters
- t2: max 16 characters
- b2: max 96 characters
- t3: max 16 characters
- b3: max 96 characters
- cta: max 8 characters

Let me draft in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan style):

t1: "連結你的銀行帳戶" - let me count: 連(1)結(2)你(3)的(4)銀(5)行(6)帳(7)戶(8) = 8 characters. Good.

b1: "安全串聯銀行與信用卡，交易紀錄自動匯入，不用再手動記帳。" - count: 安全串聯銀行與信用卡，交易紀錄自動匯入，不用再手動記帳。
安(1)全(2)串(3)聯(4)銀(5)行(6)與(7)信(8)用(9)卡(10)，(11)交(12)易(13)紀(14)錄(15)自(16)動(17)匯(18)入(19)，(20)不(21)用(22)再(23)手(24)動(25)記(26)帳(27)。(28) = 28 characters. Under 96. Good.

t2: "支出自動分類" = 支(1)出(2)自(3)動(4)分(5)類(6) = 6 characters. Good.

b2: "每筆交易自動歸入餐飲、交通等類別，一打開就看清錢花去哪。" 
每(1)筆(2)交(3)易(4)自(5)動(6)歸(7)入(8)餐(9)飲(10)、(11)交(12)通(13)等(14)類(15)別(16)，(17)一(18)打(19)開(20)就(21)看(22)清(23)錢(24)花(25)去(26)哪(27)。(28) = 28. Good.

t3: "預算提醒不超支" = 預(1)算(2)提(3)醒(4)不(5)超(6)支(7) = 7 characters. Good.

b3: "設定每月預算，快超支前即時提醒，幫你守住錢包月底不透支。"
設(1)定(2)每(3)月(4)預(5)算(6)，(7)快(8)超(9)支(10)前(11)即(12)時(13)提(14)醒(15)，(16)幫(17)你(18)守(19)住(20)錢(21)包(22)月(23)底(24)不(25)透(26)支(27)。(28) = 28. Good.

cta: "開始使用" = 開(1)始(2)使(3)用(4) = 4 characters. Good.

All within limits. Only return JSON. The user said 只回傳 JSON (only return JSON), so I should output just the JSON without markdown code fences? Code fences might be acceptable, but "只回傳 JSON" suggests pure JSON. I'll output pure JSON without code fences to be safe.
